set.body:
Outcome
Complete this user's planning and tracker-registration request; this is not implementation.

Owned scope
PLAN.md; local Mote operations in MeridianFX and ScalaDock

Prerequisites
None; first actionable task.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] PLAN.md includes measurable acceptance criteria, ownership, dependencies, support/validation matrices, and exact live Mote IDs.
- [ ] All required implementation and review tasks exist in the correct package store with full bodies, non-blocking hierarchy, and real blocker edges.
- [ ] Cross-store links use provenance and a local receipt gate; no invalid cross-store dependency edges exist.
- [ ] Every registered body, relation and dependency is read back; DAG/frontier and Mote integrity pass; only this planning task is closed.

Required evidence
Registration readback, graph validation, doctor/fsck receipts, local file links and reference hashes.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code P. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [PLAN] Codify the full acceptance plan and register the Mote graph
